description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the RustAdapter plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and plugin registration logic related to initializing, deinitializing, and managing the Rust plugin, including handling RPC calls and plugin lifecycle events.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Plugin::RustAdapter
classes.description: The main class implementing the RustAdapter plugin, managing plugin lifecycle, RPC invocation, and communication with the underlying Rust plugin implementation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up the Rust plugin implementation based on configuration and profile type.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles RPC invocation, forwarding calls to the underlying Rust plugin implementation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a communication channel (conditional on version).

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token and method (conditional on version).

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Constructs the library path or name based on inputs.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token for a service and callsign.
